description.value: The study examined structural atrophy, cue-induced BOLD activation, and cue-modulated functional connectivity in detoxified alcohol-dependent patients in relation to prospective relapse, compared with abstainers and healthy controls.

spans.text: The present findings suggest that pronounced atrophy in cortical midline structures and an increased brain response in the MPFC during processing of alcohol-related stimuli are associated with the prospective relapse in detoxified alcohol-dependent patients.

description.value: A cue-reactivity fMRI experiment was conducted in detoxified alcohol-dependent patients and healthy controls, with patients followed for 3 months and subsequently classified as abstainers or relapsers.

spans.text: A cue-reactivity functional magnetic resonance experiment with alcohol-associated and neutral stimuli.
A total of 46 abstinent alcohol-dependent patients and 46 healthy control subjects participated in our study.
